page_title: HAV 3-1 NIC | Le Havre v Nice 31/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Jerome Brisard is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kevin (Nice) was quite harsh and Jerome Brisard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+5' 3 - 1 Issa Soumare (Le Havre) scores as he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a perfect strike that goes behind the goalkeeper.
90+5' Sofiane Diop (Nice) whips in a cross from the corner, but Mory Diaw is well positioned and punches the ball away.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle. Jonathan Clauss (Nice) commits a foul after dangerous play.
87' Kevin (Nice) misses a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball floats high over the crossbar!
86' Thomas Delaine (Le Havre) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
85' Substitution. Ally Samatta makes way for Simon Ebonog (Le Havre).
82' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Morgan Sanson (Nice) replaces Tom Louchet.
82' Substitution. Younes Namli (Le Havre) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Fode Doucoure walks off.
81' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Yehvann Diouf.
80' 10:7 – the total goal attempt statistics.
77' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jerome Brisard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
75' A first-time shot by Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
74' Tom Louchet (Nice) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
72' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
72' Nice fail to score from a corner as Mory Diaw (Le Havre) leaps to collect the ball.

71' Sofiane Diop (Nice) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nice.
67' Franck Haise has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bernard Nguene (Nice) replacing Antoine Mendy.
67' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Jeremie Boga (Nice) will be replaced by Terem Moffi.
67' Here comes a substitution. Yassine Kechta is given a rest as he is replaced by Felix Mambimbi (Le Havre).
67' Here is a change. Yanis Zouaoui is going off and Didier Digard gives the last tactical orders to Thomas Delaine (Le Havre).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rassoul Ndiaye departs the field of play to be replaced by Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre).
63' Antoine Mendy (Nice) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
63' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jerome Brisard no option but to blow his whistle.

61' 2 - 1 The ball finds its way to Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) after a confusing situation inside the goalmouth. He finds some space and easily knocks the ball in with his body and alters the score to 2:1.
60' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Isak Jansson and he is replaced by Jonathan Clauss (Nice).
60' The substitution has been made. Sofiane Diop (Nice) has replaced Salis Abdul Samed.
58' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) was too forceful with his tackle and Jerome Brisard interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
55' The referee is firm and issues Issa Soumare (Le Havre) a deserved yellow card.
55' Juma Bah (Nice) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
54' Antoine Mendy (Nice) makes a strong challenge and Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
52' 1 - 1 Kojo Peprah (Nice) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball into the top left corner.
51' Jeremie Boga (Nice) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

50' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Yehvann Diouf makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
48' Jerome Brisard has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ally Samatta (Le Havre).
47' Kevin (Nice) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar.
46' The whistle blows and Jerome Brisard starts the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
45+3' Loic Nego (Le Havre) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
45+2' It looks like Salis Abdul Samed (Nice) saw red with that tackle. Jerome Brisard won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Juma Bah (Nice) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
44' Juma Bah (Nice) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
41' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jerome Brisard had an easy-decision to make.

40' Kojo Peprah (Nice) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
39' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) is able to continue to play.
38' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
37' Jerome Brisard blows for a foul after Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

36' Poor effort! The corner picks out Juma Bah (Nice) completely unmarked in the centre of the box. He has time to pick his spot with the header but makes a mess of it, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
35' Jeremie Boga (Nice) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
34' 38:62 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
31' Dangerous play by Fode Doucoure (Le Havre). Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
30' What a chance that is! Ally Samatta (Le Havre) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
29' An accurate cross finds its way to Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) who sends in a bullet header towards the middle of the target from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper makes the save.
28' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) brings an opponent down and Jerome Brisard interrupts the game.
24' Nice couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Mory Diaw (Le Havre) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
22' The game is interrupted. Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
21' Kevin (Nice) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Mory Diaw, who pulls off a comfortable save!
19' The Nice players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
16' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jerome Brisard saw the whole situation.

13' 1 - 0 What a clinical finish! Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) does superbly to meet a cross and fires from close range. The ball goes in off the left post, leaving the goalkeeper beaten. Absolutely fantastic!
12' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
11' Jerome Brisard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Salis Abdul Samed (Nice) and blew his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Le Havre.
10' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nice comes to nothing.
8' Kojo Peprah (Nice) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
5' Juma Bah (Nice) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
4' CHANCE! Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to Antoine Mendy (Nice) for his blatant foul.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Nice will kick the game off.
